title: Before Exam
statementMd:
Vasya is about to take his first university exam in about several minutes. And it's not just some ordinary exam, it's on mathematical analysis. Of course, right now Vasya can only think of one thing: what the result of his talk with the examiner will be...

To prepare for the exam, one has to study proofs of $*n*$ theorems. It is known that there will be $*k*$ examination cards on the exam and each card contains ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ccab2ac008a075768cfcbe37d558a7f5643a7c71.png) distinct theorems. Besides, no theorem is mentioned in more than one card (that is, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/17aca828c99fbd32cc94da9ea04c5b4660f188d1.png) theorems won't be mentioned in any card). During the exam several students may get the same card.

We do not know the exact way theorems are distributed by cards, however the students that took the exam before Vasya told him what theorems their cards contained. Vasya evaluates his level of proficiency in the $*i*$-th theorem by some number $*a*_{*i*}$. The level of proficiency in some card is the average of the levels of proficiency in the theorems that are included in the card. Now Vasya wants to know the minimally and maximally possible levels of his proficiency in the card he gets on the exam. Vasya wants to determine it by the data he has collected from other students. Unfortunately, Vasya has no time left to do the math and he asked you to help him.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of theorems and the number of cards correspondingly. The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$), the $*i*$-th number ($1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$) corresponds to Vasya's proficiency in the $*i*$-th theorem.

The third line contains number $*q*$ ($0 ≤ *q* ≤ 100$) — the number of people that have taken the exam before Vasya. Each of the following $*q*$ lines contains the description of a student's card: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ccab2ac008a075768cfcbe37d558a7f5643a7c71.png) integers from $1$ to $*n*$ inclusive. They are the numbers of theorems included in the card in the order in which they are enumerated in the input data. The numbers are given in an arbitrary order. It is guaranteed that the given cards are valid (that is, that all theorems in one card are different and that different people get cards that either don't contain the same theorems or coincide up to the theorems' permutation).

## Output

Print two real numbers, representing Vasya's minimum and maximum proficiency in the card he will get on the exam. The absolute or relative error should not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

## Note

Let's analyze the first sample. Vasya's proficiency in the cards whose content he already knows equals $6$ and $15.5$ correspondingly. The three theorems that are left are only enough to make one exam card. If we consider all possible variants of theorems included in the card we can see that in the best case scenario Vasya gets the card that contains theorems $4$ and $7$ (his proficiency would equal $15.5$) and in the worst case scenario he gets theorems $3$ and $5$ (his proficiency would equal $5$).

The $⌊ *x*⌋$ operation denotes taking integer part of real number $*x*$ (rounding down).
statementZhMd:
Vasya 将在几分钟后参加他的第一次大学考试。而且这并不是一场普通的考试，而是数学分析考试。当然，此时 Vasya 只能想到一件事：他与考官的交流结果会如何……

为了准备考试，需要学习 $*n*$ 个定理的证明。已知考试中会有 $*k*$ 张考卷，每张考卷包含 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ccab2ac008a075768cfcbe37d558a7f5643a7c71.png) 个不同的定理。此外，没有任何定理会出现在多于一张考卷中（也就是说，有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/17aca828c99fbd32cc94da9ea04c5b4660f188d1.png) 个定理不会出现在任何考卷中）。考试时，可能有多名学生抽到同一张考卷。

我们不知道定理具体是如何分配到各张考卷中的，但在 Vasya 之前参加考试的学生告诉了他自己所抽到的考卷包含哪些定理。Vasya 用一个数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 来评估自己对第 $*i*$ 个定理的掌握程度。一张考卷的掌握程度等于其中所包含定理的掌握程度的平均值。现在，Vasya 想知道自己在考试中抽到的考卷的掌握程度可能达到的最小值和最大值。他希望根据从其他学生那里收集到的数据确定这两个值。遗憾的是，Vasya 已经没有时间进行计算了，因此请你帮助他。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——定理的数量和考卷的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），其中第 $*i*$ 个数（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *n*$）表示 Vasya 对第 $*i*$ 个定理的掌握程度。

第三行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$0 ≤ *q* ≤ 100$）——在 Vasya 之前参加过考试的人数。接下来的 $*q*$ 行，每行包含一名学生所抽到考卷的描述：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ccab2ac008a075768cfcbe37d558a7f5643a7c71.png) 个从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数。它们按照输入数据中列出的顺序，对应考卷中包含的定理编号。编号以任意顺序给出。保证给出的考卷都是有效的（也就是说，同一张考卷中的所有定理各不相同，并且不同的人抽到的考卷要么不包含相同的定理，要么除了定理的排列顺序外完全相同）。

## 输出格式

输出两个实数，表示 Vasya 在考试中抽到的考卷的掌握程度的最小值和最大值。绝对误差或相对误差不应超过 $10^{ - 6}$。

## 说明

让我们分析第一个样例。Vasya 已经知道内容的两张考卷，其掌握程度分别为 $6$ 和 $15.5$。剩下的三个定理恰好只能组成一张考卷。如果考虑所有可能的定理组合，可以看出，在最佳情况下，Vasya 抽到的考卷包含定理 $4$ 和 $7$（他的掌握程度将为 $15.5$）；在最坏情况下，他会抽到包含定理 $3$ 和 $5$ 的考卷（他的掌握程度将为 $5$）。

$⌊ *x*⌋$ 运算表示取实数 $*x*$ 的整数部分（向下取整）。
